acceptance: The summary table of docs/incidents/REGRESSION-COVERAGE-INDEX.md (incidents, rows, covered, partial, none, untestable) is generated from the coverage-map rows, and a check verb exits 1 when it is stale.
Two PRs that each add one coverage-map row at different places in the table merge with no conflict, and the regenerated summary counts both rows.
The hand-written 'Recounted on' and 'The map now holds' prose lines are removed or generated.
fix: Treat the coverage-map rows as the single source. Render the summary counts from them with a generate/check verb on the existing derived-docs sync pattern, and drop the hand-kept count prose.
